set.body:
Scheduling lane: film. Current plan: docs/refactor/PLAN.md. Live dependency edges supersede historical sequencing below.

Current disposition, 2026-09-19; governing docs/refactor/PLAN.md.
Preserved approved film-library scope. Follow S0-S4c order and exact text parity; the earlier annotation preview does not close this ticket.

Original scope retained below for evidence; fleet procedure/assignments are historical and do not govern single-developer work.

Plan: docs/plans/2026-09-18-best-recall-to-video-mapper.md docs/plans/2026-09-17-d1a-source-to-story-plan.md §2.1-2.7, §3 S2.

The mapper's typed source view (D1B signatures) needs these core types. The D1A plan's revision 4 still owes a cold review before this slice.

Scope:
core, laws, codec (additive sub-shape only).

Acceptance criteria:
1. A fresh-context cold review of docs/plans/2026-09-17-d1a-source-to-story-plan.md is completed and its findings folded before code starts (recorded as a note here).
2. NarrativeSourceAtlas is sealed; AnchoredNarrativeAtlas and BoundProposalSurface exist with their checks; surfaceAtlas leaves the trait; lookup is map-backed.
3. EvidenceSupport.of refuses anchor/stream kind mismatch, a MediaTime axis differing from its intervals' axis, an axis foreign to the bundle, and spans outside the extent; each refusal has a law and a mutation witness; the dead mixedBundle branch is deleted.
4. textSpans is per stream; intervalsOn(axis) returns the canonical merged union, with idempotence and order-independence laws.
5. PrimaryProjection, TypedSupport and Evidence.anchors exist.
6. evidence-support/v1 has one encode-then-typed-refusal-on-0.7.0-decode court per anchor case (Text, MediaTime, Shot, Track), each with a mutation dropping a payload field.
7. LegacyAudioBinding.toMediaSupport is fixed or deleted.
8. Construction probes cover NarrativeProposalUnit, AnchoredNarrativeAtlas and BoundProposalSurface, plus a probe that nothing outside core extends the sealed atlas; SourceBundleSuite's foreign-bundle case is tested.
9. The S0 pins are unchanged.

Gate (AGENTS.md SD2/SD6): `sbt -batch clean compileAll testAll` on the merge result, then
`sbt -batch scalafmtCheckAll scalafmtSbtCheck` as a separate run; every test task in build.sbt's
testAll alias reports bound totals (56 at 0e36a7fa, after the corpus modules were added; recount if
modules change); a named mutation witness per new guard, and each compile-time-probe mutation proved
after its own clean recompile; `cd docs-site && npm run verify:examples` when public API or examples
change; fresh-context cold review in a separate pass; the commit body states the evidence and what
it does not establish.

Size: M.
set.title: [film] D1A-types S2: core substrate -- sealed atlas, EvidenceSupport refusals, TypedSupport, PrimaryProjection, evidence-support/v1
